notes: Single source of truth for all prices on the site and in the quote calculator. Edit via /ops-hq/pricing-admin.html or by hand. After editing, drop in place and reload any open page.

remedials.note: Prices for putting right EICR findings. Cable is charged at cost - the no-markup promise holds; reprice here when copper moves.
remedials.led_downlight_replacement_note: Supply and fit a fire-rated LED downlight (bathroom IP-rated where needed) in an EXISTING cut-out - like-for-like replacement, single visit. Roughly 20 material + 20 labour per fitting. A NEW lighting point is rewire_per_point.light instead - that 90 covers first and second fix over multiple visits. Set by Pete 2026-08-25 after a 4-halogen bathroom job showed 90 was wrong for pure replacements.

fault_finding.note: Fixed-price fault-finding visit: diagnose the fault (tripping breaker/RCD, dead circuit, intermittent problem), make it safe where possible, and give a written finding plus a fixed repair quote the same day. The 149 is credited in full against the repair if we do the work. Fee never rises mid-visit; a genuinely intermittent fault that needs monitoring equipment or a return visit is agreed in writing first. Set by Pete 2026-08-26 (the fault-finding offer).

occupied_property_multiplier_note: Applied to rewire_per_point labour when the property is occupied/furnished (chasing around a household in place). Set by Pete 2026-08-17 at 1.6, revised to 1.5 the same day. Base per-point rates assume new build or unoccupied.
